A '''battle''' was fought between the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Makem system]]<ref name="TEA" /> sometime between [[3973 BBY]] and [[3965 BBY]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the conflict known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="Date" /> The Mandalorians reached Makem after a [[First battle of the Lianna system|battle]] in the [[Lianna system/Legends|Lianna system]], where they were victorious. They defeated their opponents at Makem and then moved on to fight a [[Battle of the Quermia system|battle]] in the [[Quermia system/Legends|Quermia system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" />
